Beat 'payoff' says 'now about $1.9M every single day' (d22_per_part from the 2022 dividend of $704M). That figure is superseded: Coca-Cola has raised its dividend every year since; at $2.04/share (2025) Berkshire's 400M shares get about $816M a year (Yahoo Finance, Barchart), and 2026 reports give $2.12/share, about $848M. That is roughly $2.2-2.3M a day, so 'now' is false. Either say 'by 2022' / 'in 2022' (and keep 'Decades later' in 'turn' tied to 2022), or add a sourced current-year fact.

Reword to 'In 1994' / 'The year the buying finished' and relabel the doc row and bar.
